title: Unnamed Adjustments
description: Basic SMP Adjustments made for Unnamed SMP
body:
# ATTENTION
This mod is intended for the Unnamed SMP, therefore bugs and incompatabilities are highly expected. If something does not work right, you can report it on the Github page (but I might not see it).
## Features
Currently, the only two features are turning off darkness fog and disabling end portals, but more will be added as the server progresses.
